subject.title: Add gated Claw discovery and API projection

question: Should ClawHub adopt the gated `family=claw` package-discovery and `clawManifestSummary` public API as part of the experimental Claw contract before the RFC and full staged stack are complete?
rationale: The patch is additive and feature-gated, but it introduces shared API and CLI vocabulary for a new package family; source review cannot determine whether maintainers want that contract or its staged rollout.

options.title: Keep the stack draft pending sponsorship
options.body: Require RFC/product sponsorship and live enabled/disabled proof before accepting this discovery contract into the staged experimental stack.

options.title: Sponsor the gated API now
options.body: Accept the unstable discovery contract behind the deployment gate, with review continuing on the prerequisite and lifecycle PRs before any deployment enables it.

recommendation.title: Keep the stack draft pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Require RFC/product sponsorship and live enabled/disabled proof before accepting this discovery contract into the staged experimental stack.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the connected schema, publication, and discovery slices and can provide the requested runtime evidence, while final product acceptance remains with repository maintainers.
